readings.title: A New Song of Deliverance
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH has made His salvation known to the nations, remembering His loving-commitment to Yisra’ěl.
readings.text: [Psalm 98:1] Sing to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> a new song! For <dn>He</dn> has done wonders; <dn>His</dn> right hand and <dn>His</dn> set-apart arm Have brought <dn>Him</dn> deliverance. [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has made known <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> deliverance; <dn>His</dn> righteousness <dn>He</dn> has openly shown Before the eyes of the nations. [3] <dn>He</dn> has remembered <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment And <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> trustworthiness to the house of Yisra’ěl; All the ends of the earth have seen The deliverance of our <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: A Joyful Shout to the Sovereign
readings.subtitle: All the earth is called to praise with song, lyre, trumpets, and the shophar.
readings.text: [4] Raise a shout to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all <dn>את</dn> the earth; Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises. [5] Sing to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with the lyre, With the lyre and the voice of a song, [6] With trumpets and a voice of a shophar; Raise a shout before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the Sovereign.

readings.title: Creation Awaits the Judge
readings.subtitle: The sea, rivers, and mountains rejoice, for He comes to judge the world in righteousness.
readings.text: [7] Let the sea roar, and all that fills it, The world and those who dwell in it. [8] Let the rivers clap their hands, Let the mountains sing together for joy before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [9] For <dn>He</dn> shall come to judge <dn>את</dn> the earth. <dn>He</dn> judges <dn>את</dn> the world in righteousness, And <dn>את</dn> the people in straightness.

readings.title: The Reign of the Set-Apart King
readings.subtitle: Enthroned on the keruḇim, His great and awesome Name is praised as He establishes right-ruling.
readings.text: [Psalm 99:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall reign; Peoples tremble! <dn>He</dn> is enthroned on the keruḇim; The earth shakes! [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is great in Tsiyon, And <dn>He</dn> is high above all the peoples. [3] They praise <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> Name, great and awesome, It is set-apart. [4] And the strength of the Sovereign Shall love <dn>את</dn> right-ruling; <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> shall establish <dn>את</dn> straightness; <dn>You</dn> shall execute <dn>את</dn> right-ruling And <dn>את</dn> righteousness in Ya‛aqoḇ. [5] Exalt <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, And bow yourselves at <dn>His</dn> footstool, <dn>He</dn> is set-apart.

readings.title: A Forgiving and Avenging Elohim
readings.subtitle: He answered Mosheh, Aharon, and Shemu’ěl from the cloud, and His set-apart mountain is a place of worship.
readings.text: [6] Mosheh and Aharon were among <dn>His</dn> priests, And Shemu’ěl was among those calling upon <dn>His</dn> Name. They called upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and <dn>He</dn> answered them. [7] <dn>He</dn> spoke to them in the column of cloud; They guarded <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> witnesses And <dn>את</dn> the law <dn>He</dn> gave them. [8] <dn>You</dn> answered them, <dn>O</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>You</dn> were a forgiving <dn>Ěl</dn> to them, Though <dn>You</dn> took vengeance on their deeds. [9] Exalt <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, And bow down towards <dn>His</dn> set-apart mountain; For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> is set-apart.

readings.title: A Call to Worldwide Thanksgiving
readings.subtitle: Serve YeHoVaH with gladness, for we are His people; enter His gates with praise for His everlasting goodness.
readings.text: [Psalm 100:1] Raise a shout for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, All <dn>את</dn> the earth! [2] Serve <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with gladness; Come before <dn>His</dn> presence with singing. [3] Know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>He</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn>; <dn>He</dn> has made us, and we are <dn>His</dn> – <dn>His</dn> people and the sheep of <dn>His</dn> pasture. [4] Enter into <dn>His</dn> gates with thanksgiving, And into <dn>His</dn> courts with praise. Give thanks to <dn>Him</dn>; bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> Name. [5] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is good; <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting, And <dn>His</dn> truth, to all generations.

readings.title: Prayer of the Afflicted
readings.subtitle: A cry of distress from one whose days are like smoke and whose heart is withered like grass.
readings.text: [Psalm 102:1] <dn>O</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, hear <dn>my</dn> prayer, And let <dn>my</dn> cry come to <dn>You</dn>. [2] Do not hide <dn>Your</dn> face from me In the day of <dn>my</dn> distress; Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to me; In the day <dn>I</dn> call, answer me speedily. [3] For <dn>my</dn> days are consumed like smoke, And <dn>my</dn> bones are burned like a hearth. [4] <dn>My</dn> heart is stricken and withered like grass, For <dn>I</dn> have forgotten to eat <dn>my</dn> bread. [5] Because of the sound of <dn>my</dn> sighing <dn>My</dn> bones have cleaved to <dn>my</dn> flesh. [6] <dn>I</dn> have been like a pelican of the wilderness, <dn>I</dn> have been like an owl of the desert. [7] <dn>I</dn> have watched, and <dn>I</dn> am As a bird alone on the house-top. [8] <dn>My</dn> enemies reproached me all day long, Those who rave against me have sworn against me. [9] For <dn>I</dn> have eaten ashes like bread, And mixed <dn>my</dn> drink with tears, [10] Because of <dn>Your</dn> displeasure and <dn>Your</dn> wrath; For <dn>You</dn> have lifted me up And thrown me down. [11] <dn>My</dn> days are like a shadow that lengthens, And <dn>I</dn> wither away like grass.

readings.title: The Eternal Compassion of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Though the afflicted withers, YeHoVaH is enthroned forever and will arise to have compassion on Tsiyon at the appointed time.
readings.text: [12] But <dn>You</dn>, <dn>O</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, shall be enthroned forever, And the remembrance of <dn>You</dn> be to all generations. [13] <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> shall arise And have compassion on Tsiyon, For the time to favour her, The appointed time, has come. [14] For <dn>Your</dn> servants have been pleased with her stones, And they favour her dust. [15] And the nations shall fear <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And all the sovereigns of the earth <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> esteem, [16] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall build up <dn>את</dn> Tsiyon, <dn>He</dn> shall appear in <dn>His</dn> esteem. [17] <dn>He</dn> shall turn unto the prayer of the destitute, And <dn>He</dn> shall not despise their prayer. [18] This is written for a generation to come, So that a people to be created praise Yah. [19] For <dn>He</dn> looked down From the height of <dn>His</dn> set-apart place; From heaven <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> viewed the earth, [20] To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death, [21] To declare <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in Tsiyon, And <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> praise in Yerushalayim, [22] When peoples gather together, And reigns, to serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Unchanging Creator
readings.subtitle: The heavens and earth will perish and grow old, but the Creator remains the same, and His years have no end.
readings.text: [23] <dn>He</dn> has humbled <dn>my</dn> strength in the way; <dn>He</dn> has shortened <dn>my</dn> days. [24] <dn>I</dn> said, “<dn>O</dn> <dn>my</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>, Do not take me away in the midst of <dn>my</dn> days; <dn>Your</dn> years are throughout all generations. [25] “<dn>You</dn> did found the earth of old, And the heavens are the work of <dn>Your</dn> hands. [26] “They shall perish, but <dn>You</dn> remain; And all of them grow old like a garment; <dn>You</dn> change them like a coat, And they are changed. [27] “But <dn>You</dn> are the same, And <dn>Your</dn> years have no end. [28] “The sons of <dn>Your</dn> servants continue, And their seed is established before <dn>You</dn>.”

readings.title: Bless YeHoVaH, O My Being
readings.subtitle: Praise to the Creator, who is clothed in light, stretches out the heavens, and makes His messengers the winds.
readings.text: [Psalm 104:1] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>O</dn> <dn>my</dn> being! <dn>O</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have been very great: <dn>You</dn> have put on excellency and splendour, [2] Covering <dn>Yourself</dn> with light as with a garment, Stretching out the heavens like a curtain, [3] Who is laying the beams of <dn>His</dn> upper rooms in the waters, Who is making thick clouds <dn>His</dn> chariot, Who is walking on the wings of the wind, [4] Making <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> messengers the winds, <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> servants a flame of fire.

readings.title: The Foundations of the Earth
readings.subtitle: He set the earth on its foundations and established the boundaries for the waters of the deep.
readings.text: [5] <dn>He</dn> established the earth on its foundations, So that it would not totter forever, [6] <dn>You</dn> covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters stood above the mountains. [7] At <dn>Your</dn> rebuke they flee; At the voice of <dn>Your</dn> thunder they hurry away. [8] They go up the mountains; They go down the valleys, To the place which <dn>You</dn> founded for them. [9] <dn>You</dn> did set a boundary, they do not pass over, They do not return to cover the earth.

readings.title: The Provider for All Life
readings.subtitle: He sends springs for the beasts, causes grass to grow for cattle, and provides trees for birds and mountains for goats.
readings.text: [10] Who is sending the springs into the valleys, They flow among the hills. [11] They give drink to every beast of the field; Wild donkeys break their thirst. [12] The birds of the heavens dwell beside them; They sing from between the branches. [13] Watering the hills from <dn>His</dn> upper rooms; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of <dn>Your</dn> works. [14] Causing the grass to grow for the cattle, And plants for the service of mankind, To bring forth food from the earth, [15] And wine that makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make the face shine, And bread which sustains man’s heart. [16] The trees of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are satisfied, The cedars of Leḇanon which <dn>He</dn> planted, [17] Where the birds do make nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees. [18] The high hills are for wild goats; Rocks a refuge for rock badgers.

readings.title: The Order of Creation
readings.subtitle: He made the moon for appointed times and the sun for its course, ordering the cycle of night and day for beast and man.
readings.text: [19] <dn>He</dn> made <dn>את</dn> the moon for appointed times; The sun knows its going down. [20] <dn>You</dn> put darkness, and it is night, In it all the beasts of the forest creep. [21] The young lions are roaring for prey, And seeking <dn>את</dn> their food from <dn>Ěl</dn>. [22] The sun arises – they withdraw And lie down in their dens. [23] Man goes out to his work, And to his labour, till evening.

readings.title: The Fullness of His Works
readings.subtitle: The earth is filled with His possessions, from the creatures of the sea to the renewal of life by His Spirit.
readings.text: [24] <dn>O</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, how many have been <dn>Your</dn> works! <dn>You</dn> have made all of them in wisdom. The earth is filled with <dn>Your</dn> possessions. [25] There is the sea, great and wide, In which are innumerable swarms, Living creatures, small with great. [26] There do ships go; That Liviathan which <dn>You</dn> made, to play there. [27] All of them wait for <dn>You</dn>, To give their food in due season. [28] <dn>You</dn> give to them, they gather in; <dn>You</dn> open <dn>Your</dn> hand, they are satisfied with good. [29] <dn>You</dn> hide <dn>Your</dn> face, they are alarmed; <dn>You</dn> take away their breath, they die and return to their dust; [30] <dn>You</dn> send forth <dn>Your</dn> Spirit, they are created; And <dn>You</dn> renew the face of the earth.

readings.title: Everlasting Praise to the Creator
readings.subtitle: The psalmist resolves to sing to YeHoVaH forever, rejoicing in His works and calling for the end of the wicked.
readings.text: [31] The esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is forever, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rejoices in <dn>His</dn> works, [32] Who looks on the earth, and it trembles; <dn>He</dn> touches the mountains, and they smoke. [33] <dn>I</dn> sing to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> as long as <dn>I</dn> live, <dn>I</dn> sing praise to <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> while <dn>I</dn> exist. [34] <dn>My</dn> meditation on <dn>Him</dn> is sweet; <dn>I</dn> rejoice in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [35] Let sinners be consumed from the earth, And let the wrong be no more. Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>O</dn> <dn>my</dn> being! Praise Yah!
